---
title: Stuffed Tomatoes
id: MAR-0062
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 30
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 60 g mortadella
- 4 tomatoes
- 2 tablespoons parsley
- 1 tablespoon basil
- 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs
- 3 tablespoons pecorino cheese
- 1 egg
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste Salt and pepper
## Method
1. Wash the tomatoes, cut off the tops, hollow them out, and turn them upside down.
2. In a bowl, pour a generous tablespoon of breadcrumbs and 2 of pecorino; add the parsley, the coarsely chopped mortadella, the basil, the beaten egg, salt and pepper.
3. Mix and fill the tomatoes with the mixture.
4. Arrange them in a baking pan lined with the appropriate paper, sprinkle the surface with the remaining breadcrumbs and pecorino, and season with oil.
5. Bake the tomatoes at 200 °C and cook for about 15 minutes, until the surface is golden.
